product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Heavy Duty Large Screen Floor to Ceiling Mount for Portrait and Landscape Displays, Fits 50"–100" TVsDesigned for high impact commercial signage, the Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy Duty Large Screen Floor to Ceiling Mount securely supports extra large displays from 50" to 100" in portrait orientation or 75" to 100" in landscape. Built for permanent indoor installations, it delivers industrial grade strength, rigid floor to ceiling stability, and a clean architectural appearance.Making it ideal for feature displays in retail, corporate, and public environments, this mount combines heavy duty commercial grade construction with a rigid dual-column system that anchors between the floor and ceiling without requiring large wall structures. Heavy Duty Commercial ConstructionEngineered specifically for very large and heavy displays, this mount is built to withstand continuous use in demanding commercial environments such as retail signage, lobbies, transportation hubs, and corporate spaces. The heavy duty commercial grade construction delivers industrial strength performance for permanent indoor installations. Optimized for Portrait DisplaysDesigned to support single large format TVs in portrait orientation, this mount is ideal for vertical digital signage, branding elements, and wayfinding applications. The portrait-optimized bracket positions large displays for high-impact, high-visibility commercial communication. Floor to Ceiling StabilityA rigid vertical column mounts securely between the floor and ceiling, providing exceptional stability while minimizing vibration—without requiring large wall structures. Integrated features include an effortless lock mechanism, 3° vertical correction adjustment, pipe extension system, and built-in cable management, making it ideal for open or glass-heavy architectural spaces. Supports Extra Large ScreensCompatible with 50" to 100" flat panel displays and designed for commercial grade large format TVs.
